name: Kasuga (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kasuga village emblem in green: a stylised bird with outstretched wings enclosing a comma-shaped device.
history: Flag of the former village of Kasuga in Gifu Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-31.

features.role: Kasuga village emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings enclosing a comma-shaped device
